lead_independence.headline: Fishermen hook 12-foot shark at Normandy Beach on Hutchinson Island in St. Lucie County
lead_independence.lead: Jensen Beach resident and avid beach walker Kathy Green was walking along Normandy Beach on Hutchinson Island in St. Lucie County on Friday when she filmed a group of fishermen struggling with a 12-foot shark they had hooked. The fishermen unhooked the deadly beast and released it back into the water. Shark expert and conservationist Jim Abernethy believes it was a great white shark by looking at the video.
